company.name: Funding Societies
company.shortDescription: Funding Societies is a digital finance platform that provides short-term financing to SMEs through an online marketplace.
company.description: Funding Societies operates an online platform that connects individual and institutional investors with SMEs seeking loans. The platform allows SMEs to access financing quickly and efficiently, often bypassing traditional banks. The company has operations in multiple Southeast Asian countries, including Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Thailand.

productsAndServices.description: Small unsecured loans up to S$150,000 with approval and disbursement in as fast as 24 hours, intended for SMEs needing urgent financing.
productsAndServices.name: Micro Loans

productsAndServices.description: Medium to large term loans with tenors up to 36 months, tailored for SMEs requiring working capital or business expansion funds.
productsAndServices.name: Business Term Loan PRO

productsAndServices.description: A flexible credit facility providing SMEs with ready access to funds up to an approved limit, allowing multiple drawdowns and repayments.
productsAndServices.name: Revolving Credit Line

productsAndServices.description: Financing that allows SMEs to extend payment terms to suppliers by obtaining early payment funding for their accounts payable.
productsAndServices.name: Accounts Payable (AP) Financing

productsAndServices.description: A financing solution that converts outstanding invoices into immediate cash for SMEs, improving liquidity.
productsAndServices.name: Accounts Receivable Financing (Invoice Financing)

productsAndServices.description: Loans secured by property assets, allowing SMEs to borrow up to 80% of the property's value.
productsAndServices.name: Property-Backed Secured Financing
